falsifier: Any MWCC-1.2.5 function in which hoisting a local out of a loop body it is UNCONDITIONALLY REDEFINED in produces a DIFFERENT object from its unedited counterpart - which would show scope carries liveness or numbering information after all; or a case in which such a hoist changes the callee-saved numbering while leaving the instruction stream otherwise intact. Conversely, a function in which hoisting a local that IS read before its first write in the loop body proves byte-identical would show the def-use screen recorded here is too permissive and the hoist is inert even for loop-carried values. Evidence lives in the aligned view plus the raw word count: python tools/gdl/fnasm.py <unit> <fn> --diff and python tools/gdl/composed_census/wf_word_diff.py <unit> <fn> before and after the hoist, with probe.py's NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL classification as the decisive signal. subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value:
THE RULE. MOVING A LOCAL'S DECLARATION OUT OF A LOOP BODY IS NOT A LIVENESS CHANGE. A live range is decided by DEF-USE, not by lexical scope, and MWCC folds the scope difference away before codegen. If a local is UNCONDITIONALLY REDEFINED at the top of every iteration, it is dead across the back edge whether it is declared inside the loop body or in the enclosing block, and hoisting it produces a BYTE-IDENTICAL object. Do not spend a build on 'hoist X so its live range spans the loop and it earns a callee-saved register'. The screen costs zero builds: read whether X's first appearance in the loop body is a plain assignment (a def that kills the incoming value) or a read-modify-write. Only in the second case does the value cross the back edge, and only then can scope-adjacent phrasing matter at all.

MEASURED 2026-09-02 on game/movie/movieplayer.cpp::fn_800D8BCC at HEAD 0f45ae610. The three locals dst, dst2 and x are declared inside `for (y = 0; y < state->height; y += 2) { ... }` and each is unconditionally assigned in the first three statements of that body. Hoisting all three into the enclosing `if (count > 0x100)` block's declaration list measured NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL under probe.py: object bytes UNCHANGED, real 184 and differing words 95 on both sides, i.e. the construct never reached the compiler's decision point.

WHY THIS IS WORTH A RECORD RATHER THAN A SHRUG. It refutes a MANDATED STEP-1 hypothesis that had already survived a review cycle, and it refutes the specific distinction that hypothesis used to argue past the existing law. claim.law.MV_callee-saved-numbering-has-a-width-class-ahead-of-declaration-order.20260902.v1 already carries the scope note 'Do not spend a probe on a scope hoist to renumber a register', measured on a function-scope hoist of SEVEN locals in the same function. The hypothesis field of attempt.MV_fn800d8bcc-callee-saved-width-class-recolors-the-whole-function.20260902.v1 explicitly argued that result did not transfer, on the ground that 'that probe moved locals that ALREADY held callee-saved registers, so it changed naming only, whereas these two hold none'. THAT DISTINCTION DOES NOT EXIST. Both hoists are byte-identical, and for the same reason: scope carries no liveness information in either case. A hypothesis that reasons from WHICH REGISTER a local currently holds to WHETHER a scope move will reach codegen is reasoning about the wrong variable - the question is only ever def-use.

THE HOIST IS FREE, WHICH MAKES IT AN ENABLER RATHER THAN A NULL. Because the hoist is byte-identical it can be applied at zero cost to MERGE a short declaration list into a longer one, and POSITION within that longer list DOES reach codegen. Measured on the same function: with the trio appended LAST the object is byte-identical to the un-hoisted state (95 words, real 184); moved to the FRONT of the enclosing block's word class the whole-function callee-saved pile reshuffled - state r20 to r31, param_6 r22 to r21, ip r24 to r23, pal r25 to r24 - for 141 words and real 278. So the correct use of a scope hoist is as a free preparatory move that widens the declaration-ORDER search space, never as a liveness lever in its own right. Note the asymmetry this creates for denial scope: a within-trio reorder denial recorded at inner-block scope automatically covers the same reorder at enclosing scope (the two states are the same object), but it says NOTHING about the trio's position relative to the OTHER locals in the enclosing list, which is a genuinely separate axis.

PROCEDURE. Before probing any 'lengthen the live range' idea, write down the def-use of the variable from the aligned view and state where the value crosses the back edge. If it does not cross, the idea is dead at zero cost. This is discipline 1 applied to a hypothesis rather than to a record's cure: the predecessor's DIAGNOSIS (two unplaced callee-saved webs, named exactly, confirmed here by the correspondence table) transferred perfectly, while its PRESCRIPTION did not - the same split the residual-work discipline predicts.
